import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    d,e,f,g,h,k,m,p,q,w = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    b=0.648; c=0.547
    G = d + e*t + f*np.log(t) + g*t*t + h*t*np.log(t) + (k + m*t)*np.sin(w*t) + p*np.cos(w*t) + q/t
    return b*t + c*P*np.log(P) + G/P
